events.title: New demo alert!
events.summary: Happy Chimkens here and we have some news!After working on Vroomity Loops for a little longer.. we finally have a new demo ready for release! events.title: Post Comic Con Portugal bug fix!
events.summary: Hello,Anni and João from Happy Chimkens here! We heard your feedback and took note of all the bugs (and your comments on level difficulty) found during the four days of Comic Con Portugal (April 23-26). To make your experience the best it can be, we’ve fixed (almost) all of those little pesky buggers.So what has changed?You can no longer drive outside the roundabout constraints (hopefully).The “Yes” button in the retry/continue menu is now the default selection.
